subject: ist-f-dt
title: IST.F.DT.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 254 (PR.S(RD)II-8). IST-F-DT (isolated focus dictates) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: RT-ALGN (reality alignment), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From RT-ALGN: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From C-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From CULT-AF-BS: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From T-C-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information). From INTR: LANG-CY. From MT-INFO: COS-P (cosmic particulars).
